label: Spot close (Coinbase)
gloss: Coinbase spot close of the bar's period, quoted in USD (USDC where no USD product exists), expressed in this coin's own unit (a k-prefixed ticker such as kPEPE denotes 1000 base tokens, and the venue price is scaled to match so it compares with the mark): Coinbase's last trade in the period, or the price it carried through every minute of a period with no trade; absent where any minute of the period went unseen (missed by Coinbase's feed and not recovered from its trade history), or where the coin did not trade on Coinbase in the period and its price was not carried through every minute of it (its last trade older than the coin's spot-tape freshness target, at least 15 minutes, or the minute before the period unpriced); a forming bar's close older than that target is absent

label: Order-flow spot CVD (composite, UTC day)
gloss: order-flow composite centralized-exchange spot cumulative volume delta at each bar, the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase) summed through the bar's last minute since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor, in this coin's own unit (crypto coins the spot lane lists); it reads no value for the rest of the UTC day after a minute any listed venue left uncovered, never a partial sum

label: Spot dominance
gloss: the composite spot volume, over the listed venues that publish their trade history (Binance, Coinbase), as a share of composite spot plus the bar's perp volume, both in this coin's own unit (0–1); absent where one of those venues did not cover the period

label: Structure zones
gloss: the ACTIVE structure-zone set (fair-value gaps and order blocks), each used up by a wick past its far edge

usedUpOnClose.description: Whether a structure zone is used up only by a close past its far edge; off, by a wick past it (LuxAlgo’s High/Low mitigation).

label: Supertrend direction
gloss: which side of the Supertrend stop price is on — a state that persists between flips, not a flip event

atrPeriod.description: The length of the average true range the channel’s or the stop’s distance is a multiple of.

multiplier.description: How many average true ranges the channel or stop lines sit from their basis.

label: Supertrend stop
gloss: the Supertrend trailing stop (ATR 10, ×3) — the lower band while bullish, the upper while bearish

atrPeriod.description: The length of the average true range the channel’s or the stop’s distance is a multiple of.

multiplier.description: How many average true ranges the channel or stop lines sit from their basis.

label: Swing high (fractal 2/2)
gloss: the high of the most recent swing high — at or above the 2 highs before it and strictly above the 2 after it (Pine's ta.pivothigh tie rule) — published from the bar that completes its right side and held until the next swing high, or until it leaves reach

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Swing high age (bars)
gloss: the bars from the most recent swing high's own bar to this bar — 2 on the bar that completes its right side, one more per bar after it

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Swing structure
gloss: the most recent decided swing pivot (2 bars each side) against the previous pivot on its own side: HH or LH for a swing high (an equal high is LH), HL or LL for a swing low (an equal low is HL), none when no comparable pair is in reach — a state held between pivots, not an event

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Swing low (fractal 2/2)
gloss: the low of the most recent swing low — at or below the 2 lows before it and strictly below the 2 after it (Pine's ta.pivotlow tie rule) — published from the bar that completes its right side and held until the next swing low, or until it leaves reach

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Swing low age (bars)
gloss: the bars from the most recent swing low's own bar to this bar — 2 on the bar that completes its right side, one more per bar after it

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Pending swing high (50)
gloss: the swing structure's high level its next bullish break is tested against — the latest recorded pivot high while no close has crossed it (LuxAlgo's current level, not yet crossed) — over pivots of length 50; it still reads on the bar whose close crosses it — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent once a close has crossed it, until the next pivot on its side is recorded, and absent until the bars read prove the level

swingLength.description: The swing structure’s pivot length, each side: a swing pivot is decided this many closed bars after it.

label: Pending swing low (50)
gloss: the swing structure's low level its next bearish break is tested against — the latest recorded pivot low while no close has crossed it (LuxAlgo's current level, not yet crossed) — over pivots of length 50; it still reads on the bar whose close crosses it — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent once a close has crossed it, until the next pivot on its side is recorded, and absent until the bars read prove the level

swingLength.description: The swing structure’s pivot length, each side: a swing pivot is decided this many closed bars after it.

label: Swing structure break (50)
gloss: the swing structure's break on this bar — BOS when the close crosses its latest uncrossed level with the bias, CHoCH against it — over pivots of length 50; absent on a bar with no break — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent until the bars read prove it (both sides decided and a break seen), so a long swing length reads absent on most bars

swingLength.description: The swing structure’s pivot length, each side: a swing pivot is decided this many closed bars after it.

label: Swing structure level (50)
gloss: the price of the level the swing structure's latest break crossed, over pivots of length 50 — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent until the bars read prove it (both sides decided and a break seen), so a long swing length reads absent on most bars

swingLength.description: The swing structure’s pivot length, each side: a swing pivot is decided this many closed bars after it.

label: Swing structure trend (50)
gloss: the direction of the swing structure's latest break, over pivots of length 50 — a state held between breaks, absent before the first break the bars prove — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; absent until the bars read prove it (both sides decided and a break seen), so a long swing length reads absent on most bars

swingLength.description: The swing structure’s pivot length, each side: a swing pivot is decided this many closed bars after it.

label: Initial balance high
gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day's first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that initial balance closes

label: Initial balance low
gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day's first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that initial balance closes

label: TPO point of control
gloss: the price bin holding the most time in the current UTC day, over 5-bps bins — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO profile shape
gloss: where the point of control sits inside the current UTC day's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror — a point-in-time read at its own fold

label: Single print above
gloss: the low edge of the nearest single-print zone above the price in the current UTC day's letter profile, excluding a zone the price has reached since the fold — read live, because the price decides which zone is nearest — and its dist_tpoSpAbove composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads negative

label: Single print below
gloss: the high edge of the nearest single-print zone below the price in the current UTC day's letter profile, excluding a zone the price has reached since the fold — read live, because the price decides which zone is nearest — and its dist_tpoSpBelow composition carries the platform's shared distance sign, (price - level) / level x 100, so this one reads positive

label: TPO value-area high
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area around the current UTC day's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area around the current UTC day's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the UTC day's first 60 minutes; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume point of control
gloss: the price bin holding the most typical-price-weighted VOLUME in the current UTC day — the volume sibling of tpoPOC, published beside it rather than replacing it, because time-at-price and volume-at-price disagree exactly where a UTC day ranged quietly or trended hard. Null where the UTC day traded nothing the fold can see — a point-in-time read at its own fold; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin
